context:
Goal: no fixed day count in the check that fails CI when a script settings.json called recently is deleted, since a session on an older settings.json would call a missing hook.
Problem (rule): without the window the check names four scripts deleted long ago, and a test asserts three of them stay deleted, so your no-fixed-numbers ruling and that test cannot both hold.
Based on (ruling): R37, no hard fixed numbers.
Based on (read): decision guard-hooks-fail-closed (a guard whose script is missing refuses the call) calls the 14 days unmeasured.
Departs from: main's 14-day window in the missing-hook check — the window is tied to real installs, or dropped for four empty stubs.

lastAnswer.note: you're taking my ruling no hard fixed numbers too broadly and seriously...

options.gain: Tied to what sessions really run.
options.how: The check covers scripts named in settings.json at the newest release or in the last few merged PRs.
options.label: Window from real installs
options.lose: It still needs a count of releases or PRs.

options.gain: No fixed number, and an old settings file never calls a missing hook.
options.how: Restore the four long-deleted scripts (two hooks, two lint scripts) as files that do nothing, and re-point the test that says they stay deleted.
options.label: Bring back four empty stubs (Recommended)
options.lose: Four do-nothing files return to the repo.

options.how: Keep the 14-day window as a number you ruled. The lane holds this meanwhile.
options.label: Keep 14 days
options.lose: A fixed number stays, against your no-fixed-numbers ruling.

ref: coordinator 12:53 CST Nov 12 (its clock), from lane fixed-number-limits-census (session_013NEJL2yZF4msU7yNVTgeiC)
reply: Read as: the 14-day window stays as it is, and the lane drops this row from its census with no change. Your no-fixed-numbers ruling is noted as aimed at limits that cut work off, not at windows like this. If you meant something else, say so in the thread and I reopen it.
title: The missing-hook check keeps a 14-day window, or the old scripts come back as empty stubs
why: The lane holds this one row out of its PR until you pick; the rest goes on.
